patch.explanation: The not_null test on stg_customers.market_segment failed with 288 null rows. The model used nullif(trim(c_mktsegment), 'MACHINERY'), which converts any 'MACHINERY' segment to NULL, violating the not_null constraint. Changing the expression to simply trim(c_mktsegment) restores the original values and eliminates nulls, as confirmed by try_patch which shows all tests passing.
